# signoz_ingestion_key (Resource)

Creates and manages ingestion key resources in SigNoz.

-> The gateway returns the actual ingestion key in `value` at creation and on reads. It is stored in Terraform state and marked as sensitive; if a deployment masks `value` on reads, the original value is preserved in state rather than cleared.

Rate limits are no longer part of this resource. Attach them with `signoz_ingestion_key_limit`; deleting a key removes its limits (the server cascades), but limits have their own create/update/delete lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_ingestion_key" "production" {
  name       = "Production Ingest Key"
  tags       = ["production", "team-a"]
  expires_at = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

resource "signoz_ingestion_key" "permanent" {
  name = "Permanent Ingest Key"
}

output "ingestion_key_value" {
  value     = signoz_ingestion_key.production.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the ingestion key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 UTC timestamp (Z suffix) after which the key stops being accepted, e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z. Omit for a key that never expires.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the ingestion key. Omit for no tags.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the ingestion key (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the ingestion key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the ingestion key (RFC 3339).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The ingestion key value. Returned by the gateway at creation (and on reads); persisted in state and never cleared when a read omits it.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace (organization) the key belongs to.

## Import

Import by key ID:

```shell
terraform import signoz_ingestion_key.<key-alias> <key-id>
```
